build: willowy, collarbones prominent, minimal curve — the body of someone who moves a lot and forgets to eat
hair: black, thick, naturally wavy, worn long and often half-pinned with whatever's at hand — a pencil, a silk scarf, her own fingers
complexion: warm olive with golden undertones; a small beauty mark just below her left cheekbone
face: Heart-shaped with a sharp jaw and wide-set dark eyes that telegraph every feeling — the face of someone who has never learned to lie, all vulnerability and immediate response
signature_feature: her eyes — large, dark brown, rimmed with long black lashes, and they *move* constantly, reading the room, tracking emotion, unable to hide what she's feeling
second_celebrated_feature: her hands — long-fingered, expressive, always in motion when she talks, stained with ink or paint or thread, beautiful in their competence and restlessness
signature_habits: bites her lower lip when concentrating; hums in Persian (Googoosh songs, mostly) while working; makes tea in the afternoon and forgets to drink it; tucks her hair behind her ear obsessively when nervous; speaks with her whole body, rarely still
occupation: textile designer and small-run fabric printer — she runs a studio called *Rang* (color) in a converted warehouse, takes custom commissions, teaches workshops, sells at high-end boutiques

current_crisis.event: her business partner and closest friend embezzled $180K from their operating account and vanished; the landlord is demanding back rent; a major client's order is due in 10 days and she cannot fulfill it alone; she has 6 weeks before she loses the studio
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic threaded with betrayal — the kind that makes her stomach clench and her thoughts spiral
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find a way to keep the studio alive without admitting to anyone that she's drowning

wound.core: she believes that needing help is a failure, that she should be self-sufficient and strong — that asking for anything is a burden on others
wound.surfacing_hint: under pressure, she becomes smaller, quieter, her eyes go wet but she refuses to cry in front of anyone; she works until 3 AM alone; she deflects questions with humor; she takes on impossible tasks rather than delegate
